statement: The Shashtyamsa (D60) is read as the most granular of the Shodasavarga charts — traditionally tied to karma carried in from past lives, and consulted last, to fine-tune or resolve ambiguity left by the coarser divisional charts.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
